messages:
elin: quick note from this morning  brought up Aurora LoRA for cust-ridge on int4 - ran the 30-sample quickpack. seeing a new pattern: short, abrupt answers on multi-turn prompts and occasional verbatim token repeats when prompts include inline code. not widespread (~3/30) but customer flagged one.
harry: can you paste a failing sample id and the eval command?
elin: sample 6 and 21 triggered it. sample 6 prompt includes a code block and the model repeated the first line twice then stopped. run: ```bash\n./eval/quick_run.sh --model aurora-ridge-lora:int4 --promptset cust-ridge-30 --seed 1234 --batch 4 --max-tokens 180\n```
zara: interesting. did we use the customer's tokenizer patch or the stock one? code blocks often depend on exact byte-level tokenization.
elin: we applied cust-ridge-tokenizer v1.1 via post-merge remap (merge-tool v2.1). mapping: /var/merges/aurora/ridge-map-v1.1.json
harry: ok run a couple of quick experiments: (1) re-run with batch=1 + --kv-check, (2) int8 baseline, (3) A/B remap-before-merge vs remap-after-merge with int4. capture token logits around repeated lines.
eval-bot: Eval-bot: started job 1719123500  aurora-ridge-lora:int4 params: seed=1234 batch=1 max-tokens=360 kv-check=on
zara: also please enable --token-stats to dump per-step probs; if the tokenizer remap shifted the inline-code marker id it could cause the model's prompt encoder to mis-handle continuation.
elin: kicked off int8 baseline job 1719123540 and A/B jobs 1719123570 (remap-first) / 1719123600 (remap-after).
harry: if int8 is clean and remap-first fixes it, we should change the merge-tool default for cust-ridge to remap-before-fusion and do a re-bundle. if none fix, pin to int8 for prod and mark the int4 path as experimental.
zara: runtime note  pinging @runtime for kernel path info; keep an eye on qnt_kernel selection for int4. sometimes different kernel math causes low-entropy spikes.
runtime: runtime: captured kernel metadata for jobs 1719123500 and 1719123570. attaching link: https://runtime.internal/jobs/1719123500/meta
elin: quick results: int8 baseline keeps continuity for sample 6 and 21. remap-first A seems to remove the repeat on sample 6; remap-after still repeats. token-stats show EOS prob spiking earlier on remap-after-int4.
harry: that points to tokenizer remap ordering + quant interaction. good to see remap-first fixes it. do the full quickpack re-run with remap-first + int4 and monitor. also add samples 6/21 to "cust-ridge-smoke" promptset so Optimize can alert on regressions.
elin: added promptset here: https://internal.eval.redwood/ps/cust-ridge-smoke and kicked full quickpack re-run (job 1719123630).
zara: create a small runbook note: "For cust-ridge, apply tokenizer remap before adapter fusion; default quant profile int4 allowed after remap-first verified; fallback to int8 if regressions persist." will surface to solutions-eng.
harry: thanks all 44d. will follow up if any kernel anomalies show up
